nodes.title: FINISHING
widgets_values:
FINISHING

AutoFinish builds the master automatically after the queue (RIFTCAST_AUDITION prefix here - rename per project). Judge results from the *_MASTER.mp4, never the in-canvas preview.

temporal_upscale 2x on Generate = ~48fps masters via the LTX temporal latent upsampler - audio untouched, 24fps render law preserved. Great on motion; skip it for dialogue close-ups and found-footage looks.

num_frames up to 1441 (60s) single take. 241 = 10s audition.

nodes.title: LORA STACK
widgets_values:
LORA STACK

ltx23_accent_american_v2 @ 1.0 - makes accent wording obeyable in the young-voice registers the base model ignores. Load-bearing; leave it at 1.0.

ltx23_surfaces_v1 @ 1.0 - always-on material realism (no trigger word). Grounds, walls, fabric, wear.

Chain another LoRA Stacker into this stacker's lora_stack input for character/style LoRAs. Everything fuses at load on safetensors DiT paths.

nodes.title: VOICES + REFERENCES
widgets_values:
VOICES + REFERENCES

Voice casting: a clip in input/joyecho_voices/<tag>/ makes every script with that speaker tag use that voice. RiftCast cartridges install these for you.

RefPicker scans the ACTIVE script text for names matching folders under your refs root and injects identity stills at shot 1 (no_reference = silently skip when nothing matches). In designer mode this means a PACKED character's re-auditions inherit their own face - continuity for free.

The LoadImage is only a manual fallback; leave it on example.png unless you want to force a specific reference.

nodes.title: READ ME - THE 24 FPS LAW
widgets_values:
READ ME - THE 24 FPS LAW

video_fps stays at 24. Always.

LTX-2.3's joint audio-video prior is 24fps-native and fps is a hidden ACCENT dial: 25fps drifts every voice to southern British, 30fps to broad Australian - and off-24 overrides accent wording in your prompt entirely. Verified by A/B with blind phonetic review.

Want a British/Australian character on purpose? Render THEIR scenes at 25/30. Otherwise: 24, say the accent in the prompt, keep the accent v2 LoRA at 1.0.

nodes.title: TWO MODES - THE SOURCE SWITCH
widgets_values:
TWO MODES - THE SOURCE SWITCH

The RiftCast Source Switch picks what drives this queue:

PROMPT FILE - classic batch rendering. Point PromptSource at any LPFF txt or script JSON; easy-seed sets the block index.

CHARACTER DESIGNER - set the dropdowns, queue, and the character records an audition tape. The Packer cuts their voice anchor + 3 reference stills from that render and installs NAME.riftcast automatically. Re-queue with a new seed to recast; delete the file in input/riftcast/ to retire them.

Cartridges also auto-install at startup: drop any .riftcast into input/riftcast/ and just mention the character in a script.
